title: Cortical laminar boundary observation
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Observe source-defined fine anatomy with complete native geometry, explicit definitions and retained attribution.

scenes.title: Left pial boundary
scenes.prompt: Identify the selected source boundary and compare its folded course with the pial and layer VI / white matter reference surfaces. Rotate and change transparency to inspect the nested boundaries.
scenes.note: Original source: layer0_left_327680.gii.gz. Exact supplied source vertices and triangle topology are retained. This view uses the source-native surface coordinate convention.
